title: About Adair
offerPrompt: You want to ask me about Adair?
acceptLabel: If you could go back in time and tell him to stop, would you do it?

alice_about_adair_opening.dialogue:
I’ve been telling him to stop since Day 1. He’s never listened. If you mean an *actual* successful attempt at getting him to stop…

No.

alice_about_adair_end.dialogue:
…

Because then we wouldn’t have met Tyler or Jacey. I probably would’ve still met Kamil but I wouldn’t have any reason to introduce him to Adair if I hadn’t already known Ty or Jace by that point.

At the very least, we wouldn’t have grown as close to any of them like we are now.
